CommunityApplications.Profile:
A better Unraid dashboard. Vitals replaces squinting at the stock tiles with real analytics: CPU, memory, network and temperature history charted over 1h / 6h / 24h, a full array table with per-disk fill, temperature and error counters, a Docker breakdown with per-container CPU and memory, SMART health with reallocated and pending sector counts, and auto-detected GPU and UPS panels.
Everything is collected locally every minute by a shell-and-PHP collector that reads Unraid's own state files. No InfluxDB, no Grafana, no Telegraf, no external service and no telemetry leaving your server. History lives in a 24-hour RAM ring buffer plus tiny hourly rollups on the flash drive, so you get long-range trends without hammering the USB stick.
The stock dashboard is never modified — Vitals adds a page, a tile you can place wherever you like, and an optional "make it my start page" switch.
